Select exact IC50 activity rows for compounds tested against human hepatocyte growth factor receptor (CHEMBL3717). Join molecule_dictionary to activities, assays, and target_dictionary. Join compound_records on activities.record_id to get compound_key. Join docs on compound_records.doc_id to get pubmed_id or doi. Join compound_structures as an INNER JOIN to enforce presence of canonical_smiles. Filter by target chembl_id CHEMBL3717, standard_type IC50, and require both canonical_smiles and (pubmed_id or doi) to be present. Return compound_chembl_id, canonical_smiles, compound_key, pubmed_id_or_doi, assay_description, standard_type, standard_relation, standard_value, standard_units, activity_comment, target_chembl_id, target_name, target_organism. Keep all activity rows without deduplication. Sort by compound_chembl_id, canonical_smiles, compound_key, pubmed_id_or_doi, assay_description, standard_type, standard_relation, standard_value, standard_units, activity_comment, target_chembl_id, target_name, target_organism.
